help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:445  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:449  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:450  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:451  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:452  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:453  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:454  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:455  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:456  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:457  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:458  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:459  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:461  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:462  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:465  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:468  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:471  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:474  Existing destination to compute the difference set against,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:475  repeatable. Default: every other destination in the config.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:478  Repository path override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:481  Masterkey file override for the destination being initialised.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:484  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:487  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:490  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:493  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:494  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:495  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:496  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:500  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:501  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:502  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:503  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:504  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:505  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:506  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart. Use
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:507  `--cost` to see what a full-text pass over the current hits *would*
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:508  cost before asking for one; full-text matching is not implemented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:509  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:510  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:511  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:512  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:513  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:514  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:515  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:516  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:517  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:518  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:519  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:520  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:521  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:522  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:523  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:524  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:525  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:526  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:527  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:528  destination and answered for every session and nothing matched, `3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:529  could not finish — either reading it, or placing every session in time —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:530  so "nothing matched" is unproven. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:532  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:535  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:538  Emit one JSON object on stdout instead of the human report. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:539  three groups (matched / not matched / could not be placed) stay
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:540  separate fields, so a consumer cannot read an unknown as an absence.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:543  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:546  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:549  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:552  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:555  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:558  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:562  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:563  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:564  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:565  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:566  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:567  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:568  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:569  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:570  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:571  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:572  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:573  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:574  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:575  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:576  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:577  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:578  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:579  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:580  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:581  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:582  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:583  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:584  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:585  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:586  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:587  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:588  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:589  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:590  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:591  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:592  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:593  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:594  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:595  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:596  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:597  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:599  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:602  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:605  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:608  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:609  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:610  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:611  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:614  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:615  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:616  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:619  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:620  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:623  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:624  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:627  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:630  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:633  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:636  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:644  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:645  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:646  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:647  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:648  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:649  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:650  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:651  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:652  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:653  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:654  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:655  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:656  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:657  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:658  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:659  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:660  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:661  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:662  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:663  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:664  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:665  codes match `search`: 0 served the dashboard, 1 read it all and there
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:666  was nothing, 3 could not finish reading (or no key), 2 usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:668  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:669  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:671  Consume ext inbox bundles into sealed staging shards.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:672  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:673  Reads complete `deepseek-<sessionId>.json` exports from `--inbox`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:674  (skipping `.part` files), archives each as one record in a sealed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:675  shard under `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<id>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`, and retires
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:676  the source file to `<inbox>/consumed/`. Idempotent by content: the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:677  bytes are never archived twice. Prints paths/counts/sha256 only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:679  Inbox directory holding the ext exports.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:682  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:685  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:686  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:687  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:690  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:694  Read every scanner session returned by `status` into our own stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  Harness sources are opened read-only. File-backed JSONL sources use a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:697  durable byte offset plus committed-prefix SHA-256; opencode SQLite
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698  sessions use a durable logical high-water cursor. The cursor state lives
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699  under chat-stasher's own data directory, not under any harness directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:700  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:701  Exit codes: 0 = every recognised session was archivable and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:702  collected; 3 = PARTIAL — the pass ran, but at least one harness
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:703  recognised sessions this build cannot archive (the `not archivable`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:704  line), so what was written is real but incomplete; 1 = the pass failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  (collect itself errored, or individual sources could not be read).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:707  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:710  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:711  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:712  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:715  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:718  Named destination from the config. Read state is kept per
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:719  destination, so a different destination is a different debt set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:722  Destination repository this pass collects *for*. Read state is kept
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:723  per destination, so a different value is a different debt set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:726  Masterkey file override for the destination above.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:730  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:731  This command never renames a harness-owned path.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:732  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:733  Gated by `data/harness-registry-v1.json` (`seal_policy` + `seal_source`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:734  + the platform cell's `confidence`): only a harness whose policy is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:735  `rename`, with an evidence `seal_source` line **and** a `source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:736  confirmed` platform cell may be renamed. Everything else (Codex = fd-holder,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:737  opencode = sqlite, any unconfirmed harness) is refused with the active
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:738  file untouched — renaming an fd-holder silently drops its post-rename
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:739  data.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:741  Registry harness id that owns the active file (e.g. `claude-code`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  Path of a file already inside --stage to seal. Paths outside the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:745  stage are rejected and left untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:748  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:751  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:752  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:753  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:763  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:765  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:766  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:769  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:771  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:772  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:773  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:775  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:776  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:778  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:779  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:780  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:781  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:782  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:783  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:784  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:785  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:813  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:814  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:818  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:819  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:821  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:822  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:823  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:828  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:829  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:830  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:833  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:835  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:838  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:839  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:847  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:848  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:851  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:854  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:857  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:876  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:877  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:879  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:881  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:882  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:883  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:884  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:885  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:886  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:887  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:888  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:889  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:890  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:891  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:893  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:897  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:898  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:899  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:900  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:905  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  With `--rebuild --destination`, every archived session for that machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:907  is restored to a temporary child of `--stage`, the full index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:908  rebuilt, and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing snapshots
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  remain immutable. No snapshot is written until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  session restore finish, and only the named machine partition is pushed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  The rebuild is safe to re-run, but each run starts over and is not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  resumable. A same-machine snapshot found before publication restarts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide that newer session.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:924  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:925  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:927  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:928  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:929  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:930  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:932  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:933  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:934  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:938  destination rebuild. Temporary restored shards are removed after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939  the new snapshot is written.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:984

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1018  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1020  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1021  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1022  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1024  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1025  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1026  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1027  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1028  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1029  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1030  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1031  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1032  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1033  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1034  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1035

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1074  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1075  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1076  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1077  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1078  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1079  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1080  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1081  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1083  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1089  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1092  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1093  
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1094  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1095  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1096  the next time a session is read.
